problem: The file is opened in write mode, which truncates it and makes json.load fail, instead of read mode.
The loop uses range(len(items) - 1), so the last item is skipped in the total.
The mutable default argument tags=[] is shared across calls, so tags accumulate instead of starting empty each call.
Uses > instead of >=, so an item with stock exactly equal to qty is wrongly reported as not fulfillable.
Divides by 10 instead of 100, so the discount is ten times too large for a percent value.
Uses > instead of <, returning items above their reorder level rather than below it.
Using 'or 1' turns a quantity of 0 (cancelled) into 1; it should only default when qty is missing.
